text.en: Master! Still keeping dry while the rest of us drip?
text.zh-CN: 首领！别人都淋透了，您倒还干干爽爽？

text.en: Do I know you?
text.zh-CN: 我认识你吗？

text.en: I used to run your errands. Small bottles. No questions.
text.zh-CN: 我以前替您跑过腿。小瓶子，不问用途。

text.en: Then you know when to keep quiet.
text.zh-CN: 那你也该知道什么时候闭嘴。

text.en: Our friends are asking about an old duel. Unfortunate business, wasn't it?
text.zh-CN: 朋友们在查一场旧决斗。真是不幸，对吧？

text.en: Get to the point.
text.zh-CN: 说重点。

text.en: A little money could clear up my memory.
text.zh-CN: 一点钱，也许能让我想得更清楚。

text.en: We're investigating a murder. He's negotiating a consulting fee.
text.zh-CN: 我们在查谋杀，他却在谈顾问费。

text.en: You picked the wrong man to blackmail.
text.zh-CN: 想敲诈我？你找错人了。

text.en: For the record, that was his idea.
text.zh-CN: 先声明，那是他的主意。

text.en: Now, let's be reasonable about that fee.
text.zh-CN: 现在，可以好好谈谈那笔费用了吧。

text.en: You want a reward for poisoning the traveler? You put it on the blade.
text.zh-CN: 毒死旅人还想拿赏钱？毒可是你涂在兵器上的。

text.en: You poisoned him?
text.zh-CN: 是你下的毒？

text.en: This is an appalling breach of confidence.
text.zh-CN: 你这保密工作也太差了。

text.en: I supplied the poison. You did the rest.
text.zh-CN: 我提供毒药，剩下的是你干的。

text.en: Two celebrated fighters, each too busy admiring the other to notice us.
text.zh-CN: 两位大名鼎鼎的高手，忙着惺惺相惜，谁也没留意我们。

text.en: You've lied to us since we met. No more hiding behind other people.
text.zh-CN: 你从见面就在骗我们，别再躲在别人身后了。

text.en: Then come closer. You haven't seen what I can really do.
text.zh-CN: 那就过来，你还没见过我的真本事。

text.en: Kai, be careful.
text.zh-CN: 凯，小心。

text.en: I will. But this ends here.
text.zh-CN: 我会的。但这事必须在这里了结。

text.en: The two poisoners are dead. We owe the champion the truth—and an apology. Back to Winter Cottage.
text.zh-CN: 两个下毒者都死了。该把真相告诉老勇士，也该向他道歉。回冬日小屋吧。

手刃害死胡一刀的奸贼田归农、阎基。.en: Defeated the two poisoners at Rain Shrine. Return to Winter Cottage and tell the champion what happened.
手刃害死胡一刀的奸贼田归农、阎基。.zh-CN: 在雨中祠堂击败两名下毒者。返回冬日小屋，把经过告诉老勇士。

description.en: Rain drips through the old roof. Travelers shelter among the weathered pillars.
description.zh-CN: 雨水从旧屋顶滴落，旅人在风化的柱子间避雨。

description.en: A guildmaster sheltering from the rain. The apothecary recognizes him.
description.zh-CN: 在此避雨的组织首领，药师认得他。
